notes.title: HoneyCaster V2.0: The Overhaul Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868880/ec26eff0f806f50bab7d04c72d8c14e6bd50318b.png

Clifford here! Introducing the biggest update of HoneyCaster! 2.0!!

~Public Lobbies~
Lobbies are now all public, but don't worry! You can set a password to keep only those you choose in, and with lobby settings, customize your artistic experience further!

Included with public lobbies comes player permissions, allows you to keep newly joined users in check
- more options coming soon
 
~Canvas Syncing~
The biggest anticipated feature is here! The host can now sync their canvas to a user! This will later branch out to automatically sync, but for now the host designates who to sync to within the player list.

~Restricted Areas~
Need a space restricted from drawing? Wait no more! Restricted areas allows you to mark areas off-limits to creativity D:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868880/cd028ebd3d9b0dec329dd5a4773078722e99d7a7.gif

~New Menu Overhaul!~
Every menu has been Reborn! :)
You now have the option to customize the layout of your menus, moving them around, scaling them, just make sure to save your perfect layout!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868880/56a41659a18fc7e54358e6038584f712bf5ea6f3.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868880/827eaaa1738d8c27f2f778c62c3bc6035452f816.gif

Taking the time to list all the updates would take so much time... not to mention I may have forgotten to actually document the changes as they came... whoops

You can find more information on the website at https://honeycaster.weebly.com
And in HoneyCaster in the version button in settings!

Thank you all, I reiterate! I hope I can eventually make this the bestest for you all!

The massive drawing optimization has set in stone the possibilities of brush types, I can't wait!

If you find any bugs, please reach out to me on the website! Thank you!

notes.title: HoneyCaster V1.5: The Major Enhancement Update
notes.content:
Thank you to FoxinProne for helping me test ːWhiteWolfHappyː
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868880/ec26eff0f806f50bab7d04c72d8c14e6bd50318b.png

Clifford here! Introducing update 1.5 of HoneyCaster!
Languages, Zooming, Global Hotkeys, Polish, Bug fixes and some Plans ;)

~Languages~
English is the only confirmed accurate and tailored language, although I tried my best to make them all as accurate as I could I appreciate any help in correcting any mistake you may find, please let me know of anything bugging you at https://honeycaster.weebly.com

~Zooming~
Introducing the big new feature Zooming! For touching up the finer details
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868880/194d8988afcff49779ceeef35a1fc6c38581d64d.gif


Ctrl + Scroll for zooming
[F](By Default) to reset Camera Zoom and Position
Ctrl + Middle Mouse to pan the camera, no limit ;)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868880/e42fb982807311aba084ff143067820d1cb1b808.gif

~New Menu!~
A New Menu is born :)
3 additional buttons have been added to the Settings Panel
[olist]
HotKeys - For altering keybinds or toggling their global state
Colors - For changing the colors of your program :)
Languages - For changing the default language
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868880/e3dc716b81c7dfdf17d3e354d906340984d1853b.gif

Hotkeys
 Hotkeys now have the ability to have a global setting toggled allowing them to be triggered outside of the program, or only when the program is focused
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868880/eb04089152ddf19223a564e2bf11c069a3b211ed.jpg
 - Make sure to hit save! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868880/94679e0e47d0fdf6c971b1bbb559b1aeb7cafb56.gif

~Bug Fixes~

Players can now leave a lobby without it breaking, finally
Playerlist no longer stays shown when disconnected from the server
Lots of issues with the visibility of the Screen Buttons have been fixed
Host can leave and users wont have to restart HoneyCaster
Fixed no easter eggs ;)
Repaired the Shriblingtoner
Cuter Husky
Smoother Button Animations
PlayerList updates Automatically now
Many optimizations! :D


Thank you all, I hope I can eventually make this the bestest for you all!

Zooming has set in stone the framework for layers, so be on the lookout for that in the near future!
